Help now

You are not alone

Help Now

If tonight is bad, you don't have to get through it by yourself. These lines are free and confidential, and the people on them have heard everything.

In immediate danger

If you or someone with you is in danger, has taken an overdose, is having a seizure or can't be woken, call emergency services now: 000 in Australia, 911 in the US and Canada, 111 in New Zealand, 999 in the UK.
